decisions.rationale: "G6PD deficiency" names one specific disease, glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase deficiency, and is not a family of diseases. Like "C7 deficiency" in the guidelines, the named gene product makes it specific. The bare word "deficiency" is excluded as a general term, but here it is part of a specific disease name.
